title: Book One · Chapter 175: The Door Opens
story:
At ten minutes to two, the classroom is quiet.

Ronan stands beside the door. His clean shirt feels too warm. He pulls at one sleeve, then lets it go.

Leo looks down the hall.

“What if nobody comes?”

“Then we have a whole street to ourselves,” Mei says.

She puts a pencil beside the map.

Miss Wu brings in a cup of water. She puts it on her own desk, far from the paper.

“Are you ready?”

Ronan looks at Leo. Leo looks at Mei.

“I think so.”

It is two o'clock. Miss Wu opens the door.

The first visitor is Mrs Lan.

She has changed her shoes. She carries a small cloth bag. Ronan knows the bag very well.

“Mum made that,” he says.

“Yes. It is a good bag.”

Mrs Lan opens it to show him. Inside are a hand towel and her keys. There is still room for other things.

Ronan takes her to Mum’s work. She looks at the lines of thread and the small card beside it.

“She put her name here,” Mrs Lan says.

“She wrote it herself.”

“Good.”

More people walk along the hall. A small boy walks in with an older girl. Then two women stop at the door and look inside.

Ronan steps toward them.

“Welcome. This is Our River Street.”

He says it a little too loudly.

One woman smiles.

“I know River Street.”

“You can tell us if we missed something.”

She comes closer to the map.

Leo points to the corner near the school.

“We walked the route again. We put this turn in the wrong place.”

The woman follows the line with one finger. She does not touch the paper.

“That is the right turn now.”

Ronan lets his arms rest by his sides. He feels less worried now.

At the next table, Mei shows the drawings. The little boy wants to see a picture at the back.

“Come round this side,” she tells him. “You are allowed.”

He looks up at the girl with him. She nods. He walks carefully around the table.

Ronan sees Mum in the doorway.

For a second, he looks behind her.

Dad is not there.

Mum sees him looking. She comes over and touches his shoulder.

“Where shall I start? Show me, please.”

Ronan takes her to the map. He shows her the gate, the yard, and the school road.

“You have walked a lot,” she says.

“Not all today.”

“That is good. Your feet would be tired. You might sit by the door all afternoon.”

Ronan laughs.

At the door, another family is waiting. Leo is talking to the small boy. Mei has her hands full of drawings.

Ronan looks at Mum.

“I must go there.”

“I can look by myself.”

He goes back to the door.

The new visitors look around. “Where can we put our bags?” they ask. Ronan finds a dry place by the wall. He points to the first drawing. “Start here,” he says.

Soon, the quiet room is full of voices. Someone remembers a shop. Someone finds their own house. “Why does this arrow point two ways?” someone asks.

Ronan cannot answer every question.

Sometimes he asks Leo. Sometimes he calls Mei. Once, he asks a visitor, “Can you show me? Which line do you mean?”

Mum stays by her cloth bag for a while. A woman asks her about the pocket. They talk, and Mum shows her the inside.

Ronan sees them laugh.

Then a small hand pulls at his sleeve.

“Where is the river?” the little boy asks.

Ronan bends down beside him.

“Come. I will show you.”
studyGuide:
## 重点表达
- visitor：来参观的人。
- thread：线。
- welcome：欢迎。
- arrow：箭头。

## 理解
1. Ronan 遇到不会回答的问题时怎样做？
2. Mum 在展示中有怎样的独立参与？
